paite: Huan, Pathianin, Noa leh longa a kianga thil hing chiteng leh gan tengteng omte a theigigea: huan, Pathianin leitung lamah huih a nungsak a, huchiin tui a hongdai panta hi.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

paite: Tui thukpi nakte leh van tohlette leng a hongkikhakta a, van akipana vuah hongju leng theu sakin a hong omta a;
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

paite: Huchiin, tui lei apan a kiam giaigiai taa; huchiin, ni ja leh ni sawm nga a man nungin tui a hong tawm deuhta hi.
english: The waters receded from the earth continually. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters decreased.

paite: Huchiin, long a kha sagihna ni sawm leh ni sagih niin Ararat tangah a hong kingata hi.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

paite: Huan, tui a kha sawmna tannin a kiam giaigiai jela; huan, kha sawmna ni khat niin mual vumte a hongkimuta hi.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.

paite: Huan, ni sawm li nungin hichi ahia, Noain a long tohlet bawl a hongta a;
english: It happened at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

paite: Huan, va ak khat a khah kheta a; huai a pawt kheta a, lei akipan tui a kan khit masiah a vial lenlen hi.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

paite: Huan, leitungah tui a tawmta hia tawm nailou chih theihna dingin vakhu a khah khe nawna;
english: He sent out a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

paite: Himahleh vakhuin tukna ding him him a mu keia, a kiangah longah a kik nawna, tui lah leitung pumpiah a om lai ngala: huchiin, polamah a khut a golh khiaa, a man a long sungah a kiangah a la lut nawn hi.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned to him into the ship; for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

paite: Huan, ni sagih dang a ngak nawn laia; huan, vakhu long akipanin a khah khe nawna;
english: He stayed yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

paite: Vakhu nitaklamin a kiangah a honglut nawna; huan, ngaiin, a mukin olive nah loh tung a hontuaha; huchiin, Noain leiah tui a tawmta chih a theita hi.
english: The dove came back to him at evening, and, behold, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

paite: Huan, ni sagih dang a ngak nawn jela; huan, vakhu a khah khe nawna; huan, a kiangah a hong kik nawn ta kei hi.
english: He stayed yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, a kum za guk leh kum khatnaah, a kha khatna ni khat niin, tui lei a kipan a kangta: huchiin, Noain, long khuhna a koihsuana, a ena; huan, ngaiin leitung a hulta hi.
english: It happened in the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.

paite: Huan, a kha nihna ni sawm nih leh ni sagih niin lei a hulta hi.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

paite: Huan, Pathianin Noa kiangah thu a genna,
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

paite: Long akipan pawtin, nang pawt inla, na ji leh na tapate leh na tapate jite leng na kiangah pawt uhen.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, and your wife, and your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

paite: Sa tengteng laka thil hing chiteng na ompih te, vasate, gante, ganhing leitunga khupboha pai chiteng te toh na kiangah pikhiain, leitungah chi pha taka chi tampi suanga a hongpunna ding un, chiin.
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

paite: Huchiin, Noa a pawta, a tapate leh a ji leh a tapate jite leng a kiangah a pawt uhi;
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

paite: Sa chitengte, ganhing chitengte, vasa chitengte, leitunga tangthei peuhmah te amau chi omdan bang chiatin long akipan a pawta uhi.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

paite: Huan, Noain Toupa dingin maitam a bawla; huan, sa siang chiteng laka leh vasa siang chiteng laka a laa, maitamah halmang pumpiaknate a lanta.
english: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

paite: Huan, Toupan tua namtui a jaa; huan, Toupan, a lungsimin, Mi jiakin leitung ka hamsiat nawn kei ding, mi lungsim ngaihtuahnate lah naupang neu a hih a pana gilou ahi ngala; tua ka gawt bangin thil hing chiteng leng ka gawt non sam kei ding.Lei om laiteng buh leh buh lak te, kho vot leh kho lum te, nipi leh phalbi te, sun leh jan te a bei kei ding, a chi hi.
english: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake, because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I ever again strike everything living, as I have done.

paite: Lei om laiteng buh leh buh lak te, kho vot leh kho lum te, nipi leh phalbi te, sun leh jan te a bei kei ding, a chi hi.
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.”
